lines.text: Jesus got into a boat, crossed over, and came to His own town.
Some men brought a paralytic on a mat, and Jesus saw their faith and forgave his sins.
Some of the priests said to themselves, "This man is blaspheming," but Jesus knew what they were thinking.
Jesus asked which was easier, then told the paralytic to pick up his staff and go home.
The man got up and went home, and the crowds were filled with awe and glorified God.
